premise: Stargazing as night falls, Astronomer drifts all the way across the plain to the crater; Robo-dog finds her and they follow her own footprints back to the beacon at the hatch.
inspiration: Hansel and Gretel's pebble trail (Grimm), turned: on the Moon nothing blows the trail away, and the way home is the way you came.
lesson: Every step you take can bring you home.
learning: Footprints on the Moon last for ages: there is no wind or rain to wipe them away.

en-US.title: Footprints Home
en-US.text: {canvas:nightfall 12s} [softly] Night was falling on the Moon. {astronomer:enter} Astronomer didn't notice. {astronomer:go to crater} She was {astronomer:live hold} walking and stargazing, one step, one star, one step, one star… When she lowered her binoculars, {astronomer:live resume} she was right across the plain, at the edge of the crater. {astronomer:face surprised} And it was getting dark. Which way had she come? {robodog:enter} Robo-dog came trotting over — {astronaut:enter} Astronaut had sent him. {robodog:go to astronomer} {robodog:face happy} {sfx:beep} He scanned the ground and wagged his antenna tail. There, pressed in the grey dust, were her footprints, every single one. On the Moon, footprints last for ages: no wind or rain ever wipes them away. {astronomer:face happy} {astronomer:go to hatch} {robodog:go to hatch} Step by step, they followed the trail back. {canvas:floodlights 10s} The floodlights came on, and the {beacon:enter} beacon unfolded, stood up tall and {beacon:live hold} switched on its light. {all:face happy} Home. Behind them ran two trails, side by side: one of boots, {robodog:hop} one of paws.

es-ES.title: Huellas hasta casa
es-ES.text: {canvas:nightfall 12s} [softly] Caía la noche en la Luna. {astronomer:enter} Astrónoma ni se dio cuenta. {astronomer:go to crater} {astronomer:live hold} Iba andando y mirando las estrellas: un paso, una estrella, un paso, una estrella… Cuando bajó los prismáticos, {astronomer:live resume} estaba al otro lado de la llanura, en el borde del cráter. {astronomer:face surprised} Y se estaba haciendo de noche. ¿Por dónde había venido? {robodog:enter} Perro robot llegó trotando: lo había mandado {astronaut:enter} Astronauta. {robodog:go to astronomer} {robodog:face happy} {sfx:beep} Escaneó el suelo y movió su cola de antena. Allí, marcadas en el polvo gris, estaban sus huellas, todas y cada una. En la Luna las huellas duran muchísimo: no hay viento ni lluvia que las borren. {astronomer:face happy} {astronomer:go to hatch} {robodog:go to hatch} Paso a paso, siguieron el rastro de vuelta. {canvas:floodlights 10s} Se encendieron los focos, y la {beacon:enter} baliza se desplegó, se enderezó y {beacon:live hold} encendió su luz. {all:face happy} En casa. Detrás de ellos quedaban dos rastros, uno al lado del otro: uno de botas {robodog:hop} y otro de patitas.

beep.prompt: two cheerful little electronic beeps from a friendly robot dog
